source_observations: The guide describes pre-generation counts including request-structure tokens.
The count reference exposes the eight copied fields listed below, but not the four excluded generation controls.
The count response has object=response.input_tokens and input_tokens. Snapshot/account support and count-endpoint pricing were not established by an API request.

generation_controls_not_in_count_referen.max_output_tokens: Output limit; remains 2048 in the exact generation request.
generation_controls_not_in_count_referen.store: Response storage control; remains false in the exact generation request.
generation_controls_not_in_count_referen.stream: Response transport control; remains false in the exact generation request.
generation_controls_not_in_count_referen.service_tier: Generation service tier; remains default in the exact generation request.

payload_mapping.unknown_or_new_generation_fields: Stop; do not drop them silently or extend this mapping.
payload_mapping.inner_input: Keep input as the identical string, including embedded task, output schema and actual read-only view. Do not replace it by a summary or tokenize selected fields only.
payload_mapping.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False; same canonical encoding as the frozen builder.
payload_mapping.basis: Projection onto the published count parameters for this fixed text-only request. This is a design choice derived from the reference, not observed account compatibility.

future_host_protocol_if_separately_adopt: Before dispatch, verify current environment, fixed source hashes, case admission, prices, run accounting and fresh non-overwriting output paths.
Obtain the authoritative read-only view and read trace, then build the exact generation-request bytes with the fixed builder. For R5 use the actual resumed store; fixtures cannot certify live input.
Save the generation bytes and SHA-256, trial/case/version/state/view hashes, reader identity and method-record SHA-256 outside old records.
Derive and save the count bytes and SHA-256 using only the declared projection. Validate all fixed settings, absence of forbidden fields, and unchanged input and instructions.
Reserve a count attempt before dispatch in the separately adopted accounting mechanism; perform at most one count request for this trial, with no retry, fallback, probe generation or JSON repair.
Retain start/end time, endpoint, request hash, HTTP status, provider request ID if returned, and raw response bytes or transport failure. Do not store credentials.
Require HTTP 200, parseable JSON, object=response.input_tokens, and a nonnegative integer input_tokens at most 8192; reject booleans, missing data, errors and an unverified origin.
Only an authenticated host observation linked to this exact request may establish a bound. A manually entered number, fixture usage or sample response is not sufficient.

Bind the observed count as upper_bound to the exact generation-request SHA-256, fixed model, method hash and raw count receipt. Save the linkage; never infer model identity from a field the count response does not contain.
Immediately before generation, compare the complete request bytes/hash and relevant source/read linkage again. Any change invalidates the bound and stops this run instead of recounting or retrying.

Dispatch the unchanged generation bytes once through the separately bound host path. Keep count attempts separate from the seven generation attempts, while enforcing the adopted total cap and the USD 1 run budget.
Retain later usage and any count/usage mismatch as a deviation, stop later dispatch, and preserve failures. Later usage cannot retrospectively supply a missing pre-dispatch bound.

accounting_revision_candidate.meaning: Reviewable alternative only. It raises total requests, not generations. It is not an interpretation of, override to, or authorization under the current form.

offline_method_status: No supported whole-request offline bound established in the reviewed sources. This is not a claim that such a method is impossible.
rejected_substitutes: Visible-text tokenization or UTF-8 bytes plus undocumented framing allowance
max_output_tokens=2048 or truncation=disabled as proof of the separate 8192 input cap
The received fixture usage.input_tokens=900 or a count example from documentation
A001-A004 fixture requests as bounds for later real saved-state reads
Post-generation usage as a pre-generation check
